# Fenza Facade Engineering

> Fenza Facade Engineering is a dedicated building-envelope manufacturer serving projects across India, producing curtain wall, structural glazing, aluminium windows and doors, cladding, louvers and architectural elements — engineered and fabricated on its own aluminium line in Gurugram, Haryana. It takes on projects across Delhi NCR (Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Faridabad, Ghaziabad, Sonipat), Chandigarh, Punjab, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Jaipur and Rajasthan, Lucknow and Agra, Ahmedabad and Gujarat, Pune and Bengaluru, among others.

Fenza is a separate legal entity within the Hagerstone group, focused exclusively on facades. Its registrations and certifications are held in its own name. Technical values published by Fenza are indicative until confirmed per project against the approved system and the facade consultant's specification. Project experience attributed to Akhilesh Kumar Singh (Director — Facade Projects) is his own career record; Fenza's own project portfolio is being built.

## Facade system families
- [Curtain Wall](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/curtain-wall): Aluminium mullion-and-transom curtain walling, fabricated on our end-milling line so transoms seat square against mullions and the joint stays watertight.
- [Structural Glazing](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/structural-glazing): Flush glazed facades where the glass is bonded to a concealed aluminium carrier frame, leaving only a fine silicone joint on the outside.
- [Spider & Point-Fixed Glazing](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/spider-glazing): Point-supported glazing for atria, lobbies and entrance screens, where the glass is carried on stainless routels rather than a frame.
- [Casement Windows](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/casement-windows): Side-hung, top-hung and fixed aluminium windows built the traditional way — profiles cut to a 45° mitre, hardware prepped on the copy router, and corners mechanically crimped for a tight, square joint that does not rely on welding.
- [Sliding Windows & Doors](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/sliding-windows-doors): Two, three and four-track sliding systems on butt-jointed, end-milled frames.
- [Slide & Fold Doors](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/slide-and-fold-doors): Multi-panel folding doors that stack clear of the opening, for terraces, balconies and openable frontages.
- [Frameless Glass Doors](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/frameless-glass-doors): Patch-fitted toughened glass doors for lobbies and entrances, running on floor springs with stainless patch fittings top and bottom.
- [Metal & Composite Cladding](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/cladding): Cassette and tray cladding carried on an aluminium sub-frame fabricated on our line.
- [Rain-Screen Ventilated Facade](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/rain-screen-facade): A drained and back-ventilated outer skin on a thermally isolated carrier system, with the cavity left open so moisture and heat can escape behind the panel.
- [Louvers & Sun-Shading Fins](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/louvers): Extruded aluminium blades for solar shading, plant screening and facade articulation.
- [Railings & Balustrades](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/railings): Structural glass balustrades on extruded base-shoe channel, and aluminium post-and-rail systems, for balconies, terraces, stairs and edge protection.
- [Skylights & Canopies](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/skylights): Overhead glazing and entrance canopies on thermally isolated aluminium rafter-and-purlin framing, with internal gutters and condensation channels designed into the section.
- [Pergolas](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/pergolas): Aluminium pergola structures with fixed or adjustable aerofoil blades, drained through the frame so rainwater runs down concealed gutter posts rather than off the edge.

## Company
- [Systems overview](https://fenzafacade.com/systems): All thirteen facade system families across curtain wall, glazing, fenestration, cladding, solar control and architectural elements, with a full system index (codes FZ-CW to FZ-PG, variants and typical data).
- [Sectors](https://fenzafacade.com/sectors): The eight building types the Fenza system range serves — commercial towers, corporate offices and IT parks, residential high-rise, hospitality and serviced apartments, retail and mixed-use, institutional and healthcare, aviation and public infrastructure, industrial and factory.
- [Project record](https://fenzafacade.com/projects): Ten facade and envelope developments led by Akhilesh Kumar Singh — DLF Building 8 and DLF WeWork (Cyber City), Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (Hyderabad), Max Hospital (Saket), Krisumi Waterfall Residences, Adani Samsara Vilasa, M3M, Broadway Service Apartment, Anygraphics Factory and Dee Development. IMPORTANT: this is his own career record, NOT Fenza Facade Engineering's completed projects; Fenza is newly established and its own portfolio is being built.
- [Manufacturing](https://fenzafacade.com/manufacturing): The Gurugram aluminium line — double-head cutting to ±0.1 mm, copy routing, corner crimping, end-milling, the two construction methods (mitred-and-crimped, butt-jointed notch-and-tenon), finishes and reference standards (IS 1948, ASTM E283/E330/E331, EN 12207/12208/12210).
- [Quality & Safety](https://fenzafacade.com/quality-safety): In-process checks, batch verification, machine condition monitoring and sign-off before despatch; site safety planned before work begins, covering work at height, PPE, lifting, welfare and emergency preparedness. Installation is by Fenza's own site teams.
- [Leadership & Projects](https://fenzafacade.com/leadership): Akhilesh Kumar Singh, Director — Facade Projects, 25+ years in facade engineering, structural glazing, cladding and high-rise execution.
- [About Fenza](https://fenzafacade.com/about): A facade-only manufacturer; the Hagerstone-group relationship stated as backing.
- [Resources](https://fenzafacade.com/resources): Product catalogue download; system datasheets and test reports in preparation.
- [Facade glossary](https://fenzafacade.com/glossary): More than sixty facade and curtain wall terms in plain language (mullion, transom, spandrel, U-value, structural glazing, rain-screen, ASTM E283/E330/E331 and more), each linked to the Fenza systems it relates to. General industry definitions; test standards are described by what they measure.
- [How facades are tested](https://fenzafacade.com/testing): The facade mock-up and the three tests usually run on it, in order: air leakage (ASTM E283), water penetration (ASTM E331) and structural / wind load (ASTM E330), explained by what each one measures. General explanation only, not a statement of Fenza's test results; applicable standards and pressures are set per project by the specification and the facade consultant.
- [Journal](https://fenzafacade.com/journal): Plain-language guides for specifiers and developers on facade systems, testing and specification. General guidance, not a specification; standards and values are confirmed per project.
- [Facades for India's climates: what changes from Delhi to Bengaluru](https://fenzafacade.com/journal/facades-for-indian-climates): A facade that works well in Delhi NCR can struggle on the coast. How glass, shading, frames, drainage and finishes should change across India's composite, hot-dry, coastal, heavy-monsoon and moderate climates.
- [How to choose a facade contractor in India: a checklist](https://fenzafacade.com/journal/choosing-a-facade-contractor-in-india): What to check before you appoint a facade contractor anywhere in India, from who actually fabricates to testing, installation, quotes and what the contract should say.
- [Monsoon-proof facades and windows: how to keep the rain out](https://fenzafacade.com/journal/monsoon-proof-facades-and-windows): Most monsoon leaks have ordinary causes: wind-driven rain, blocked drainage, failed sealant and poor sill details. How to design, test, install and maintain facades and windows so they stay dry.
- [Stick vs. unitised curtain wall: how to choose](https://fenzafacade.com/journal/stick-vs-unitised-curtain-wall): Curtain wall is not one product but a family of ways to build the same glazed skin. The main choice is where the work happens: on the building, or in the factory.
- [ACP vs. solid aluminium cladding: which one?](https://fenzafacade.com/journal/acp-vs-solid-aluminium-cladding): Two cladding panels can look identical from the street and still be very different products. Here is how ACP and solid aluminium compare, and how to choose.
- [What ASTM E331 actually tests](https://fenzafacade.com/journal/what-astm-e331-tests): A leaking facade is rarely a surprise: it is usually something a water test would have caught. Here is what the standard test does, and what it does not tell you.
- [Structural glazing: how glass is held without a visible frame](https://fenzafacade.com/journal/structural-glazing-explained): From the street, structural glazing looks like an unbroken sheet of glass. Here is how it is held, what the two main types are, and what to check before you specify it.
- [Spider glazing and glass fins: how point-fixed glass works](https://fenzafacade.com/journal/spider-glazing-and-glass-fins): Spider glazing makes a glass wall look almost frameless. It works because the glass is held at points rather than along its edges. Here is how that is done well.
- [Rain-screen cladding: why the gap behind the panel matters](https://fenzafacade.com/journal/rain-screen-cladding-the-gap): A rain-screen looks like cladding, but its performance comes from what you cannot see: the gap behind the panels. Here is how the layers work together.
- [Thermal breaks: why aluminium frames need insulation inside them](https://fenzafacade.com/journal/thermal-breaks-in-aluminium-frames): Aluminium is strong, light and slim, and it conducts heat very well. A thermal break is how a frame keeps those advantages without becoming a heat path.
- [Choosing facade glass: toughened, laminated and double-glazed units](https://fenzafacade.com/journal/choosing-facade-glass): Glass on a facade is rarely just glass. Each type does a different job, and the right one depends on safety, heat, sound and how it will be held.
- [Casement or sliding windows: how to choose](https://fenzafacade.com/journal/casement-or-sliding-windows): Both windows let in air and light, but they open, seal and age differently. Here is how they compare, and how to match the window to the room.
- [Slide-and-fold doors: what to check before you specify](https://fenzafacade.com/journal/slide-and-fold-doors-what-to-check): Slide-and-fold doors can open nearly the whole width of a wall. They are also a system with many moving parts, so a few decisions early on make a big difference.
- [Louvers and sun-shading fins: how they cut heat gain](https://fenzafacade.com/journal/louvers-and-sun-shading-fins): The best place to stop the sun is outside the glass. Louvers and fins do that, and they also give a facade depth and rhythm. Here is how to use them well.
- [Glass balustrades: what to check before you specify](https://fenzafacade.com/journal/glass-balustrades-what-to-check): A glass balustrade keeps the view and protects the edge. It is also a safety element, so how it is fixed, and what the glass does when it breaks, matter.
- [Movement joints: why a facade must be allowed to move](https://fenzafacade.com/journal/movement-joints-in-facades): A facade looks fixed, but it is not still. Heat, wind and the building's own settlement all move it. Movement joints are how it gets through that without damage.
- [Anodised, powder-coated or PVDF: choosing an aluminium finish](https://fenzafacade.com/journal/anodised-powder-coated-or-pvdf): Three finishes cover almost every aluminium facade. They look different, behave differently outdoors and cost differently. Here is how they compare.
- [What to send a facade manufacturer for an accurate quote](https://fenzafacade.com/journal/what-to-send-a-facade-manufacturer): A quote is only as good as the information behind it. This checklist covers what a facade manufacturer needs from you, and what to do when you do not have it all yet.
- [Contact](https://fenzafacade.com/contact): Facade enquiries and RFQs from anywhere in India. Manufacturing in Gurugram, Haryana.

## Locations
Every Fenza facade is engineered and fabricated on its one aluminium line in Gurugram; Fenza has no offices in other cities. Each page covers the city's buildings, climate, the facade systems that suit it and common questions.
- [Locations across India](https://fenzafacade.com/locations): Index of the cities and regions Fenza takes facade projects in.
- [Facades in Delhi](https://fenzafacade.com/locations/delhi): Curtain wall, structural glazing, windows, cladding and louvers for Delhi's hospitals, institutions, offices and homes; composite climate with summer heat, dust and a short, heavy monsoon.
- [Facades in Gurugram (Gurgaon)](https://fenzafacade.com/locations/gurugram): Home of Fenza's fabrication line; curtain wall and glazing for office towers and IT campuses, and balcony doors, windows and railings for high-rise residences.
- [Facades in Noida](https://fenzafacade.com/locations/noida): Glazed offices and IT campuses, insulated factory envelopes and high-rise housing across Noida and Greater Noida.
- [Facades in Faridabad](https://fenzafacade.com/locations/faridabad): Cladding, glazed admin fronts, windows, doors and railings for Faridabad's factories, offices and high-rise housing in Greater Faridabad.
- [Facades in Ghaziabad](https://fenzafacade.com/locations/ghaziabad): Windows, balcony doors and glass balustrades for residential towers in Indirapuram, Vaishali and Raj Nagar Extension, plus glazing and cladding for commercial and industrial buildings.
- [Facades in Sonipat & Panipat](https://fenzafacade.com/locations/sonipat): Glazing, spider glazing, cladding and louvers for university campuses, Kundli's industry and Panipat's textile mills along the GT Road corridor.
- [Facades in Chandigarh](https://fenzafacade.com/locations/chandigarh): Windows, doors, structural glazing, cladding and railings across Chandigarh, Mohali and Panchkula, with architectural controls and cold winters in mind.
- [Facades in Ludhiana & Punjab](https://fenzafacade.com/locations/ludhiana): Showroom glazing, factory cladding and premium-home windows, doors and pergolas in Ludhiana, Jalandhar, Amritsar, Patiala and across Punjab.
- [Facades in Amritsar](https://fenzafacade.com/locations/amritsar): Hotel and commercial glazing, frameless glass entrance doors, windows and slide-and-fold doors for a pilgrimage city with cold Punjab winters.
- [Facades in Shimla & Himachal Pradesh](https://fenzafacade.com/locations/shimla): Thermally broken windows, glazing, snow-load skylights, cladding and railings for hill hotels, homes and the Baddi industrial area; hill-site logistics planned at quote stage.
- [Facades in Dehradun & Haridwar](https://fenzafacade.com/locations/dehradun): Monsoon-ready windows, rain-screen cladding, curtain wall and skylights for institutions, hotels, homes and the Haridwar industrial estate in the earthquake-prone foothills.
- [Facades in Jaipur](https://fenzafacade.com/locations/jaipur): Louvers, solar-control glazing, cladding and pergolas for a hot, semi-arid city with heritage controls near the walled city and monuments.
- [Facades in Bhiwadi & Neemrana](https://fenzafacade.com/locations/bhiwadi): Industrial cladding, skylights, louvers and glazed admin fronts for factories on the Delhi–Jaipur industrial belt.
- [Facades in Lucknow](https://fenzafacade.com/locations/lucknow): Curtain wall, structural glazing, skylights, windows and cladding for government, institutional, hospital and commercial buildings.
- [Facades in Agra](https://fenzafacade.com/locations/agra): Hotel glazing, glass entrance doors, windows, louvers and pergolas in Agra, Mathura and Vrindavan, with controls near protected monuments in mind.
- [Facades in Ahmedabad & Gujarat](https://fenzafacade.com/locations/ahmedabad): Solar-control glazing, louvers, curtain wall and cladding for a hot, dry climate in Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, GIFT City, Vadodara, Surat, Rajkot and Kutch.
- [Facades in Pune](https://fenzafacade.com/locations/pune): Monsoon-ready curtain wall, windows, rain-screen cladding and louvers for IT parks, factories and residential towers.
- [Facades in Bengaluru (Bangalore)](https://fenzafacade.com/locations/bengaluru): Curtain wall, structural and spider glazing, louvers and skylights for tech campuses, offices and homes in a mild, rainy climate.

## Notes
- Fenza manufactures the building envelope only; it does not undertake interiors, fit-out, MEP, PEB or civil work.
- Contact details (email, phone, precise factory address) are being confirmed and are not yet published.
